fact: On 12 March 2026 UNECA, in collaboration with the Government of Tanzania, convened a national validation workshop on the draft Tanzania Electronic Data Governance Strategy in Dodoma, where regulatory authorities, academic institutions and sectoral agencies gave feedback that informed refinements to the strategy, and the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology closed it.
Minister Jerry Silaa opened a stakeholder forum in Arusha and questionnaires for entrepreneurs and investors on the national startup policy, to expand to major cities, The Citizen reports.

Parliament's Standing Committee on Infrastructure invited members of the public and other stakeholders, in a statement of 20 October 2026, to give views in person on 26 October 2026 or in writing on the proposed ratification of the AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection.
